:::: {.content-visible unless-format="revealjs"}
1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa cubes >}} Inventory**.

1. Select a record or find your record by applying a filter or searching for it.^[[Working with the inventory](/guide/inventory/working-with-the-inventory.qmd#search-filter-and-sort-records)]

1. In the left sidebar that appears for your record, click **{{< fa file >}} Documents** and select the **Latest** tab.^[[Work with document versions](/guide/documentation/work-with-document-versions.qmd)]

1. Click on a Development type file.^[[Working with documentation](/guide/documentation/working-with-documentation.qmd#document-overview)]

    <!-- Either log an artifact on this overview page, or via a specific documentation section. Both methods will allow you to associate an artifact with a documentation section.  -->

1. On your record's documentation page, click **{{< fa square-plus >}} Add Artifact**.

1. Select the artifact type^[[Manage artifact types](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd)] you want to add:

   - Validation Issue
   - Policy Exception
   - Limitation

1. On the modal that opens, provide information for your artifact.

   If the modal includes an Attachments field, click **{{< fa circle-plus >}} Select Files** to upload files to it. Each file uploads as soon as you pick it, and you can remove a file by selecting **Delete File** from its **{{< fa ellipsis-vertical >}}** menu before you submit.

1. When you are done, click **Add {Artifact Type}** where `{Artifact Type}` is the artifact type you want to add to submit the artifact. The button is available once all your files have finished uploading.

   You can also upload attachments to your artifact after it is created.^[[Manage attachments on artifacts](/guide/validation/update-artifacts.qmd#manage-attachments)]

::::

:::: {.content-hidden unless-format="revealjs"}
a. In the left sidebar that appears for your record, click **Development** under {{< fa file >}} Documents.

b. On your record's documentation page, click **{{< fa plus >}} Add Artifact**.

c. Select the [artifact type](/guide/validation/manage-artifact-types.qmd){target="_blank"} you want to add:

   - Validation Issue
   - Policy Exception
   - Limitation

d. On the modal that opens, provide information for your artifact, including files in any Attachments field.

e. When you are done, click **Add {Artifact Type}** where `{Artifact Type}` is the artifact type you want to add to submit the artifact.

   You can also [upload attachments to your artifact](/guide/validation/update-artifacts.qmd#manage-attachments){target="_blank"} after it is created.

::::
